ElevenLabs alternatives

ElevenLabs: Lifelike voices, voice cloning, dubbing and voice agents. If it isn't quite right, here are 14 other AI voice and audio tools from Radar, in Radar's order.

  1. 1KokoroA tiny open text-to-speech model that sounds natural and runs right in the browser.Open source
  2. 2WhisperOpenAI's open speech recognition, transcribes and translates nearly any language.Open source
  3. 3Wispr FlowDictation that works in any app and tidies up what you said as you speak.Free plan
  4. 4Adobe PodcastMakes a laptop-mic recording sound like it was made in a studio.Free plan
  5. 5HumeExpressive voices that understand and answer with emotion.Free plan
  6. 6CartesiaUltra-fast voice generation for real-time voice agents.Free plan
  7. 7KrispRemoves background noise and echo from calls, and takes the meeting notes.Free plan
  8. 8MurfStudio-quality voice-overs from text, with many voices and languages.Free plan
  9. 9WellSaidNatural AI voices for training, ads and product narration.Paid
  10. 10SpeechifyReads documents, PDFs and web pages aloud in natural voices.Free plan
  11. 11NaturalReaderText-to-speech for reading anything aloud, in the browser or an app.Free plan
  12. 12Resemble AIVoice cloning and speech generation, with deepfake detection built in.Paid
  13. 13VoicemodA real-time voice changer for games, streams and calls.Free plan
  14. 14DeepgramFast speech-to-text and voice APIs for developers.Free plan

Free to start: Kokoro, Whisper, Wispr Flow.
